policies.text: Transport capacity clearance is granted when an operator maintains a total fleet size of at least 10 jets.
Preferred carrier status is assigned to an agency possessing approval for regional routing that maintains a minimum annual on-time arrival rate of 90 percent.
Approval for regional routing requires an operator with transport capacity clearance.
Top-tier dispatch qualification is awarded when a handler records a minimum quarterly volume of 400 express deliveries.
Selection for corporate flight bookings is restricted to providers possessing preferred carrier status.
A top-grade passenger transit standard is granted when a provider secures a customer satisfaction score of 85 percent or higher.
An eco-friendly fleet certification is awarded if a company operates at least 30 electric shuttle vans.
Cross-border excursion authorization is conferred upon any firm holding an International Tour Operator Accreditation.
Priority freight clearance is given to any vendor maintaining a storage facility of at least 50,000 square feet.
